notes.title: RushOut at the Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We're very excited to participate in the Steam Next Fest with our very own demo! 

Join us in the celebration for indie games, check out our and other developers' demos, and most importantly, have fun! :)

Also, if you have any feedback for the game, feel free to share it with us in Steam discussions, or join our Discord here: https://discord.gg/hrfyhHt6Uu

- The RushOut Team
